description: Use when a summary from check_paper is not enough: inspect claim-level reproduction results, acceptance tolerances or earlier attempts. The full public record for one paper: outcome and qualifiers, summary, assurance, the attempt history (released and superseded versions with reasons), every claim checked with the published value, the re-run value, the registered tolerance, the check kind and the verdict, plus evidence links. Unlisted arXiv IDs (bare, arXiv: prefixed, or whole https://arxiv.org/abs/ or /pdf/ URLs) return code_facts (NOT a reproduction) and the optional rerun request, fetching public metadata for that id from arXiv, Hugging Face and GitHub without caller information. The code link's origin is stated and unverified.

paper.description: arXiv ID (1607.01759), DOI (10.1126/science.abb9789), an arXiv/doi.org/openrepro.org URL, the paper's title, or a name it is known by (fastText, PINNs, the Leiden algorithm)
